description.from:
A versioned legacy loader accepting pre-canonical keys during migration, with a warning on every load, validation that flags surviving legacy keys, and a dated removal milestone.

Must cover both migration surfaces or it will be removed while one survives: the `pii_signals` layer name **and** the hard-coded `pii:` subject-key exemption in `assertCanonicalSubjectKey`.

Definition of done: the loader is deleted on its milestone and validation proves no annotation reaches the evaluator through a legacy key or a loader exemption.
description.to:
Delete the temporary canonical-migration compatibility loader and every hard-coded legacy exemption after migration and readiness validation.

Removal covers the `pii_signals` layer alias, the `pii:` mention-key exemption, legacy component/flow string identities, and any fixture-only compatibility shape introduced during migration.

This task is intentionally separate from introducing the loader. It begins only after canonical corpus and fixture migrations, packet/layer scope migration, and baseline readiness validation prove that no accepted record requires compatibility.

Definition of done: canonical loaders reject every legacy shape, the evaluator has no legacy identity path, documentation names only the canonical contract, and the readiness audit reports zero accepted legacy records.

title.from: Legacy gold loader with a dated removal milestone
